items.title: Base change of the connected component scheme cut out by a section
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: In the situation of a morphism with a section, where X^0 is the closed subscheme supported on the connected components meeting the section, the lemma computes its base change: the connected components of the fibre product cut out by the lifted section are exactly the inverse image of X^0. The proof works fibre by fibre: the section point lies in X^0_y, which is therefore geometrically connected over the residue field, and the two inclusions between the base-changed component subscheme and the fibre of X^0 are argued separately, one via connectedness of the base change and one via connectivity of the image. Retained author proof at lines 8201-8215.
